title: 2 Hour Guided Boat Tour in Gig Harbor and Narrows Bridges
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is our most popular tour that brings in all the best sights and sensations of life on Puget Sound. This is an interactive tour! Our guides and crew have the top experience and perspective in the area and we love to share it! We take-in the beauty of our quaint "Maritime City" then go boldly out onto the open waters of the Tacoma Narrows to gather views from under our two major suspension bridges. We see wildlife like Bald Eagles, Great Blue Heron, seals and cute little seabirds. Our ex-US Navy boat has a smooth comfortable ride. Safety is our first priority. Our boats and captains are certified and licensed by the US Coast Guard. This is a fun, quality trip to remember! (Senior Age is 62.)
